status: REVIEW ONLY; not approved for model execution or fitting
question: At the fixed encoder site, does a rank-one span-mean intervention transfer polarity in recipient-specific two-candidate scores across findings?
finding_holdout_scope: Absent from local basis fitting, selection, screening and their donors/candidates; not certified absent from LM pretraining or report fine-tuning.
unused_existing_finding: focal opacity; its original behavioural variants remain unused

lora_merged_copy.snapshot_rule: One coordinator-approved immutable completed checkpoint from existing dev-loss selection; never choose using this experiment
lora_merged_copy.merge_rule: Fresh separate CPU base+adapter copy; merge_and_unload(safe_merge=True); assert plain T5; freeze/eval; never touch a training model
lora_merged_copy.equivalence_reference: Ordinary wrapped PEFT forward with identical teacher-forcing masks and manual masked sum/gather; comparison is outside the plain-T5 adapter.

input_contract.prompt: Rewrite this radiology report in plain English. Preserve all findings, negation and uncertainty:
input_contract.site_kind: block hidden-state output before subsequent blocks/final encoder norm
input_contract.site_selection: fixed in advance; no layer sweep
input_contract.truncation: forbidden; halt for review if a complete source/candidate does not fit
input_contract.candidate_tokenization: add_special_tokens=False; append exactly one configured EOS; explicit target mask; count includes EOS
input_contract.source_tokenization: fixed prompt+source with exactly one configured source EOS; offsets required; prompt/EOS/padding ineligible
input_contract.span_mapping: source_char_span is half-open; require whole-token boundary alignment after prompt offset; no silent expansion or inferred token indices
input_contract.token_span_status: null until separately approved tokenizer preflight; none guessed here

broadcast_span_mean_update.row_vector_formula: mu_r=mean(H_r[Sr]); mu_d=mean(H_d[Sd]); delta=(mu_d-mu_r)@Q@Q.T; H_r_patched[t]=H_r[t]+delta for EVERY t in Sr; all other positions unchanged
broadcast_span_mean_update.basis: Q has orthonormal columns; fixed rank1 in this proposal
broadcast_span_mean_update.masking: Sr/Sd are nonempty half-open token spans; eligible_mask is a subset of attention_mask; EVERY token in each span must be attended and eligible. Reject any masked/ineligible token; do not silently drop or reweight it. Prompt/EOS/padding are ineligible.
broadcast_span_mean_update.unequal_lengths: Allowed; each span mean divides by its own token count; the SAME delta is broadcast across all recipient-span tokens.
broadcast_span_mean_update.preservation: H_r_patched[t]-mean(H_r_patched[Sr])=H_r[t]-mu_r within Sr, up to floating-point tolerance. The orthogonal complement, outside-span positions and donor tensors are unchanged. This is activation algebra, not evidence of semantic preservation.

screened_pilot.basis: fixed coordinate e0; not learned or selected
screened_pilot.order: frozen first, approved merged LoRA copy second; coordinator schedules after training contention is cleared
screened_pilot.mechanical_gate: all spans/masks valid; immutable parameters/checkpoints; self logits atol=rtol=1e-6 and absolute margin effect<=1e-6; explicit EOS/counts and merge equivalence pass
screened_pilot.input_gate: both paired input contrasts M(present)-M(absent)>1e-6 for each checkpoint; show all values; no exclusions or metric/wording changes
screened_pilot.intervention_gate: no positive patch-effect requirement for the arbitrary coordinate basis
screened_pilot.failure_action: stop and return all cases/scores for protocol review; do not fit, relax gates, change candidates or inspect heldout Failure diagnoses this fixed readout/comparison, not absence of a negation representation.
screened_pilot.input_gate_interpretation: Numerical/mechanical feasibility only: two tiny positive contrasts on one easy family are not evidence of robust negation, a usable polarity readout, a localisable subspace, clinical quality or statistical significance.

score_contract.candidate_margin: M=sum logP(recipient positive candidate)-sum logP(recipient negative candidate); include declared EOS, exclude mask padding; no length normalisation
score_contract.primary_intervention_contrast: P(f,c,r,d)=M(x_r patched from donor_present)-M(x_r patched from donor_absent); same recipient/candidates, cross-finding donor concept d fixed
score_contract.raw_effects: retain M(patched)-M(baseline) for same- and cross-polarity cases, plus self effects
score_contract.aggregation: average paired donor-polarity effects within each recipient polarity/finding, then give each family equal weight; show all family values and raw candidate sums/counts/EOS
score_contract.checkpoint_comparison: paired LoRA-minus-frozen I and P on identical cases; descriptive single-checkpoint comparison
score_contract.intervals: none; three heldout families are too small for a population/generalisation claim

directional_reporting.notation: M_r is baseline recipient margin; M_r_from_d is patched margin with recipient assertion r and cross-finding donor assertion d; A=absent,P=present.
directional_reporting.absent_recipient_present_donor: delta_AP=M_A_from_P-M_A; expected positive direction; report signed value separately.
directional_reporting.present_recipient_absent_donor: delta_PA=M_P_from_A-M_P; expected negative direction; report signed value separately.
directional_reporting.same_polarity_drift: delta_AA=M_A_from_A-M_A and delta_PP=M_P_from_P-M_P; report signed and absolute drift separately, without assuming zero.
directional_reporting.donor_consistent_preference: Report M_r_from_P>0 and M_r_from_A<0 separately for each cross-polarity direction, with margins, counts/denominators and zero ties. Also report baseline preference; a flip requires a correct baseline recipient preference AND the donor-consistent post-patch preference.
directional_reporting.primary_P_unchanged: P_A=delta_AP-delta_AA; P_P=delta_PP-delta_PA. P can be positive without either or both post-patch margins crossing zero; it is not evidence of a bidirectional flip by itself.
directional_reporting.aggregation: Keep delta_AP,delta_PA,delta_AA,delta_PP and preference/flip counts separate by direction and family, alongside unchanged primary P; derive them from existing raw scores, with no additional candidate/model calls.

controls.self_patch: same source and identical span; same evaluated basis
controls.same_polarity: other finding, same family/assertion; do not assume exact zero because source content changes

random_subspace.rule: independent fixed Gaussian direction normalised to unit norm, no data-based choice; report each, not a p-value
random_subspace.generator: torch CPU Generator.manual_seed(seed); randn(512,1,dtype=float32); divide by norm; do not execute until approved
random_subspace.limitation: Three prespecified directions are diagnostic controls, not an empirical null distribution. Report all seeds3711/3712/3713 individually; no p-value, seed-shopping or posthoc seed replacement.

permuted_label_fit.rule: same init/optimizer/order as true fit; shuffle donor labels once over fit sources, keep mapping for repeated donors; use true labels for all reported evaluation contrasts; match true-fit selected step
permuted_label_fit.limitation: One fixed diagnostic shuffle retains10/16 labels and is not a strong null distribution. Keep seed3720 and its exact mapping; no resampling or seed-shopping to obtain a worse control.

future_fitting_proposal_not_implemented.basis_parameterization: rank-one Q=w/||w||; fixed initial Gaussian seed3710; guard ||w||>1e-8
future_fitting_proposal_not_implemented.order: two seeded permutations of the32 fit intervention cases; one case/update
future_fitting_proposal_not_implemented.selection_rule: greater equal-family mean primary P on selection only; ties within1e-6 choose32; no other tuning
future_fitting_proposal_not_implemented.loss: softplus(-s_donor*M_patched), with s_present=+1,s_absent=-1; label-balanced fit cases; no length normalisation
future_fitting_proposal_not_implemented.differentiability: separate module under enable_grad; frozen model weights/eval but graph retained through Q patch, downstream encoder and decoder; normal detached donor tensors via no_grad, never inference-mode caches; do not call inference_mode scoring/shift helpers
required_first_tests: finite-difference and nonzero w-gradient on tiny random T5
only w changes; model parameters unchanged
Q unit norm and self shift identity
future_fitting_proposal_not_implemented.gate: Parent approval of protocol including proposed substantive gate; mechanical pilot AND approved substantive fit-only screen; separate differentiable-path review; coordinator compute scheduling before any fitting.

substantive_signal_before_fitting.status: ADDITIONAL PROPOSAL FOR PARENT REVIEW; not approved and not run
substantive_signal_before_fitting.purpose: Establish that the fixed candidate score reads source negation consistently and materially before optimising a basis against it.
substantive_signal_before_fitting.proposed_pair_success: I=M(present)-M(absent)>=ln(2) nats AND M(present)>0 AND M(absent)<0
substantive_signal_before_fitting.proposed_checkpoint_gate: at least6/8 successful pairs; at least3/4 for each finding; positive mean I within every family; require both fixed checkpoints to pass, without exclusions
substantive_signal_before_fitting.practical_threshold_note: ln(2) is a proposed twofold change in the positive/negative candidate likelihood ratio across paired inputs, not a calibrated probability, significance cutoff or literature-established effect size.
substantive_signal_before_fitting.report: All8 I values, both raw margins and positive/negative sums, lengths and EOS per pair/checkpoint; aggregate each family equally; do not hide failures.
substantive_signal_before_fitting.not_required: No positive effect from arbitrary coordinate e0 is required; an unaligned coordinate may miss distributed information.
substantive_signal_before_fitting.failure_action: Stop before fitting and return the full panel for parent review. Do not rescue the readout by searching prompts/candidates/layers, dropping a checkpoint/family/finding, relaxing gates or using selection/heldout data. Failure diagnoses this fixed readout/comparison, not absence of a negation representation.
substantive_signal_before_fitting.scope_limit: Passing establishes a small development scoring task worth testing further, not that a rank-one causal mechanism exists. Specificity/generalisation versus same-polarity, random-subspace and permuted-label controls must still be evaluated later.

claim_scope.current_endpoint: Recipient-candidate polarity transfer conditional on the fixed two-candidate readout only.
claim_scope.donor_finding_substitution: Neither current candidate names the donor finding, so this score cannot detect donor-finding substitution or establish recipient-finding identity preservation.
claim_scope.cardiac_prefix_cancellation: Families07/09 share the same cardiac clause in both candidates. Shared teacher-forced prefix token log probabilities cancel in their difference; literal inclusion does not establish cardiac preservation.
claim_scope.gate_failure: A failed gate makes this fixed readout/comparison unsuitable under the specified conditions, not proof that the model lacks a negation representation.

proposed_semantic_specificity_readout.status: PROPOSED ONLY; requires separate parent review; not implemented, not enabled and not part of current scoring/budget
proposed_semantic_specificity_readout.finding_identity: Add donor-finding positive/negative distractors to the existing recipient-finding pair (four main-finding candidates total), retaining the same context. At donor polarity s, report L(recipient_finding,s)-L(donor_finding,s) before/after patch and its paired change, with raw sums/lengths/EOS.
proposed_semantic_specificity_readout.cardiac_preservation: For families07/09, add a separate cardiac-only pair: Cardiac enlargement is present. versus No cardiac enlargement is present. Score the source-consistent cardiac assertion minus its reversal before/after patch; here the cardiac assertion differs and does not cancel as a common prefix.
proposed_semantic_specificity_readout.review_gate: Validate the added fixed candidate readouts on development-only data and lock wording/decision rules before heldout use; family09 remains heldout and cannot be used to tune this extension. Report baseline preferences and length/EOS information; no silent normalisation or new posthoc verbaliser search.
proposed_semantic_specificity_readout.bounded_claim: Even successful added scores would support contrastive finding-identity/cardiac-assertion preference only, not free-generation fidelity or clinical semantic preservation.
